title: Theming using CSS Modules
body:
The current theming strategy in `react-instantsearch` is to have BEM CSS Classes but allow people to use any technique implemented by https://github.com/markdalgleish/react-themeable.

1. Is this (BEM Classes) the right approach for a React based library?
2. Should we use CSS Modules instead?

https://github.com/css-modules/css-modules
https://github.com/javivelasco/react-css-themr
react-toolbox allows them https://github.com/react-toolbox/react-toolbox#prerequisites

I have 0 experience using CSS modules, but for sure we want to be compatible with them.

Allowing other theming techniques is nice, especially if we are gonna wrap `react-instantsearch` in `instantsearch` v2
